prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1118; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be identified as the passenger in the vehicle, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were sitting and what happened?
A: I was in the front passenger seat. We were stopped at a light in Sugar Land, and then the car behind us hit us from the back. It was a hard hit.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I was looking at my phone, so I didn't notice it until I felt the jolt. My head snapped forward and then back against the seat.
Q: Did you hit anything with your head or body?
A: I don't think I hit the dashboard or window, but my head moved fast. I felt dizzy right after.
Q: Did you get medical attention?
A: The driver called for an ambulance. They took me to the emergency room. They said I had a concussion and told me to rest and avoid screens for a while.
Q: What symptoms are you still experiencing?
A: Headaches most days, and bright lights bother my eyes. I get tired faster than usual, and I've had trouble concentrating at work.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the emergency visit?
A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment with my primary care doctor, and I'm scheduled to see a neurologist.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still recovering and I want to make sure my medical bills are handled properly. I'll send you the discharge papers.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
